basic_details.job_title: RRC NR Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Drama Artist, Kathak Dancer and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Drama Artist (Male/Female) for Acting, Classical Kathak Dancer for Dance
basic_details.short_information: Railway Recruitment Cell, Northern Railway (RRC NR), New Delhi, Across India, has invited applications for 2 posts in 2 roles under Advt No. RRC/NR/02/2026/CQ. The posts include Drama Artist (Male/Female) for Acting, Classical Kathak Dancer for Dance. The online application is open from 6 November 2026 to 6 December 2026.

application_fee.all_candidates_except_those_be_fee: Rs. 500 (Rs. 400 refunded on actually appearing in the written examination)
application_fee.sc_fee: Rs. 250 (refunded on actually appearing in the written examination)
application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online mode; service charge borne by the candidate. Last date to pay the fee: 6 December 2026.

age_limit.details: Age relaxation for all posts: SC/ST 5 years, OBC-Non Creamy Layer 3 years, Ex-Servicemen (more than 6 months service after attestation) Service rendered in Defence plus 3 years, PwD (40% and above) UR 10 years, OBC-NCL 13 years, SC/ST 15 years, Domiciled in Jammu & Kashmir 01/01/1980 to 31/12/1989 5 years, Serving Group C / erstwhile Group D Railway staff, casual labour and substitutes with 3 years service Up to 40 years of age (UR), 43 (OBC-NCL), 45 (SC/ST), Quasi-administrative offices of the Railway Length of service or 5 years, whichever is lower, Widowed, divorced or judicially separated women not remarried Up to 35 years of age (UR), 38 (OBC-NCL), 40 (SC/ST).

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Degree/ Diploma/ Certificate in field of Drama (Acting) from Govt. recognized institute; Passed 12th (+2 stage) or equivalent with not less than 50% marks in aggregate for NTPC categories, OR Matriculation plus Course Completed Act Apprenticeship approved by NCVT/SCVT for technician categories, OR Matriculation plus ITI approved by NCVT/SCVT for technician categories. Age limit: 18 to 30 years. Pay: Level-2 of Pay Matrix 7th CPC. Practical demonstration in the relevant field

exam_pattern.details: Negative marking: 1/3 of the marks for the question deducted for every wrong answer Minimum 40% marks in the written examination to be eligible for the next stage; relaxation for reserved category as per Railway Board Rules Question paper bilingual; candidates choose Hindi or English in the application form

how_to_apply: Apply online through www.rrcnr.org between 06.11.2026 and 06.12.2026.
Tick the box at the end of the notification undertaking that you have read the notification and instructions.
Click APPLY ONLINE and choose Login for already registered candidates or New Registration.
Complete the dashboard parts: Registration Form, Application Form, Payment of Examination Fee, Uploading Documents, Online Payment Details Print, Application Details/Print.
Upload photo, signature, thumb impression and the required certificates.
Complete the application in all respects within the last date.
important_instructions: Expected date of online written examination and assessment of talent: January 2027 Date, time and venue of the test and Practical Demonstration/DV will be displayed on www.rrcnr.org No TA/DA/accommodation; SC/ST candidates with proper community certificate get free travel authority (2nd class) Original documents with one set of self-attested photocopies to be brought on the day of document verification No post is reserved for SC, ST and OBC; all posts open to all candidates

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RRC NR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 6 December 2026. Applications opened on 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in RRC NR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Drama Artist (Male/Female) for Acting, 1 Classical Kathak Dancer for Dance.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for RRC NR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 6 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All candidates except those below: Rs. 500 (Rs. 400 refunded on actually appearing in the written examination). SC/ST, Ex-Serviceman, PwBD, Women, Minorities and Economically Backward Classes: Rs. 250 (refunded on actually appearing in the written examination).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 30 years (as on 1 January 2027). Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC-Non Creamy Layer 3 years, Ex-Servicemen (more than 6 months service after attestation) Service rendered in Defence plus 3 years, PwD (40% and above) UR 10 years, OBC-NCL 13 years, SC/ST 15 years, Domiciled in Jammu & Kashmir 01/01/1980 to 31/12/1989 5 years, Serving Group C / erstwhile Group D Railway staff, casual labour and substitutes with 3 years service Up to 40 years of age (UR), 43 (OBC-NCL), 45 (SC/ST), Quasi-administrative offices of the Railway Length of service or 5 years, whichever is lower, Widowed, divorced or judicially separated women not remarried Up to 35 years of age (UR), 38 (OBC-NCL), 40 (SC/ST).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Level-2 of Pay Matrix 7th CPC for Drama Artist (Male/Female) for Acting, Level-2 of Pay Matrix 7th CPC for Classical Kathak Dancer for Dance.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Degree/Diploma/Certificate in Drama (Acting) or Classical Kathak Dance from a Govt. recognized institute, plus 12th with 50% marks, or Matriculation plus Course Completed Act Apprenticeship or ITI approved by NCVT/SCVT. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Persons appointed as Clerk-cum-Typist must acquire typing at 30 w.p.m. in English or 25 w.p.m. in Hindi within two years of appointment. Candidates already in Govt. service must apply with NOC from the employer. Applicants must bring their own musical instrument or cultural uniform for the Practical Demonstration. No relaxation in Education and Cultural qualification is permissible.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates debarred for life from RRB/RRC examinations, or debarred for a period not yet completed, need not apply.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written Test / Computer / Tablet Based Test (CBT)/(TBT). Practical Demonstration (Talent test). Document Verification. Medical Examination.
